text:
Alyssa (CS): heads-up — MedFlow onboarding p95 on /v1/chat jumped ~600ms over last 48h. renewal review in 5 days. proposing a low-risk trial: route short triage summaries to med-compact-5B-int8 and keep gpu-13B for long context. run quick offline QA on triage_suite, then a 12h canary.

Gabe (Solutions): please paste p50/p95 and a representative prompt. want to estimate savings and quality impact.

Alyssa (CS): p50 240ms, p95 1130ms, avg payload ~110 tokens (but many 300+). prompt example: "Summarize immediate red flags from the latest visit notes". historically compact-5B-int8 had small wording shifts but kept entities intact.

Noah (SRE): any correlation with cache misses or import windows?

Alyssa (CS): spikes at ~02:45 UTC and ~17:10 UTC, seems tied to nightly ingestion + preview bursts. routing should reduce tail by keeping short requests off the heavy runtime.

Gabe (Solutions): rollout plan: 1) offline eval on triage_suite (metrics: entity-F1, ROUGE, hallucination); 2) routing rule: prefer med-compact-5B-int8 when request.tokens <= 600; 3) canary 12% for 12h with auto-rollback if feedback_rate>1.5% in 30m or hallucination>1% by automated checks; 4) collect UI flags + small A/B sample.

Dr. Patel (Customer): clinicians want a quick flag button and a short reason dropdown (missing follow-up / wrong finding / other). auto-rollback required for clinician flows.

Noah (SRE): will provision canary and add rollback hooks. setting thresholds: feedback_thresh=0.015, eval_window=30m. also will add a temporary concurrency cap on ingestion during canary windows.

Gabe (Solutions): Redwood Console routing snippet (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
rules:
  - name: med-compact-pref
    match: route.path == "/v1/chat" and request.tokens <= 600
    prefer: med-compact-5B-int8
    fallback: gpu-13B
    canary_percent: 12
    window: 12h
    auto_rollback_on_feedback: true
```

Alyssa (CS): assigning action items: @Gabe run offline eval + A/B, @Noah stand up canary + rollback, @Dr. Patel enable feedback widget and reason menu. i'll update the renewal note with expected outcomes.

canary-bot: Canary created (id: canary-8384729100). Observability: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8384729100

Noah (SRE): canary live. initial metrics: canary p95=480ms, baseline p95=1120ms. quick smoke QA (n=25): 4 phrasing-only diffs, no entity mistakes. feedback widget turned on.

Gabe (Solutions): early math: p95 for routed short requests down ~57%, token-cost for those requests down ~46%. if offline eval shows entity-F1 delta <1.5% and hallucination <0.8% recommend ramp to 50% over 24h.

Dr. Patel (Customer): feedback toggle live. clinicians flagged 2 items (style), provided reasons. need immediate rollback if any incorrect meds appear.

Noah (SRE): auto-rollback not triggered. feedback rate 0.6% over first 4h. streaming alerts to #cs-renewals.

Gabe (Solutions): offline eval finished: entity-F1 delta -0.7%, ROUGE drop 1.0, hallucination automated check 0.25%. artifacts uploaded to renewal folder.

Alyssa (CS): adding renewal summary: "Proactive perf mitigation executed: med-compact-5B-int8 canary reduced p95 on routed traffic by ~57% with projected cost savings ~45%; quality within guardrails. recommended ramp plan attached." will include flagged examples in the deck.

Dr. Patel (Customer): thanks team — this looks promising. keep feedback enabled during the ramp and please notify before any full switch.

Noah (SRE): next step: ramp to 50% in 12h if no regressions; keep auto-rollback and ingestion caps. will post ramp metrics here. :rocket:
